canonical_title: Periodic Maintenance and the Historical Record

one_line_answer.text: Periodic maintenance encompasses maintenance operations that go beyond the prevention of equipment breakdown.

cites.quote: periodic maintenance
comprehensive periodic program encompasses maintenance operations that go
beyond the prevention of equipment breakdown

bangla_explanation: Periodic maintenance-কে preventive maintenance-এর চেয়ে ভালো ধরা হয়।
কারণ এটা শুধু breakdown ঠেকায় না, তার বাইরেও অনেক কাজ ধরে।
প্রতিটা কাজের জন্য আলাদা schedule আর আলাদা work order থাকে।
সব maintenance আর মেরামত লিখে রাখতে হয় historical record-এ, যাতে যন্ত্রের পুরো ইতিহাস জানা যায়।

example.en: A lathe machine has separate schedules for lubrication and electrical checks. Each gets its own work order.
example.bn: একই মেশিনের lubrication আর electrical check-এর আলাদা schedule ও work order।

short.modelAnswer:
Periodic maintenance encompasses maintenance operations that go beyond the prevention of equipment breakdown. It is preferred over preventive maintenance.
1. It identifies who, what, when, where, why and how repetitive operations are done.
2. Each operation has a separate schedule and work order.
3. All maintenance and repair is kept in a historical record.

checks.note: cblm06-sc1-q3: answer key p.31 gives three options: (a) 'is the same as preventive maintenance', (b) 'encompasses maintenance operations that go beyond the prevention of equipment breakdown', (c) 'is the result of combining preventive maintenance with corrective maintenance'. Only (b) matches the information sheet p.26, which says periodic maintenance is PREFERRED OVER preventive (so not the same); (c) is not in the information sheet. Card writes the p.26 version.
